name: OPERATION
description: b7:6 = 10 PSU ON, 01 immediate OFF (no sequencing); b5:0 reserved; margining not supported

name: ON_OFF_CONFIG
description: b4 enable CONTROL pin + serial; b3 serial ON/OFF via OPERATION (needs CONTROL pin asserted); b2 respond to CONTROL pin; b1 CONTROL polarity (0 = active low); b0 CONTROL action (0 = programmed delay, 1 = immediate)

name: CAPABILITY
description: b7 PEC (1 = supported); b6 max bus speed (0 = 100 kHz, 1 = 400 kHz); b5 SMBALERT pin (1 = supported); b4:0 reserved

name: QUERY
description: Ask whether a command is supported

name: VOUT_MODE
description: Mode and parameters of output-voltage data formats

name: COEFFICIENTS
description: byte5 R, byte4:3 b (low,high), byte2:1 m (low,high); defaults R=0 b=0 m=1

name: FAN_CONFIG_1_2
description: b7 fan1 installed; b6 0=RPM cmd 1=duty; b5:4 pulses/rev (00=1,01=2,10=3,11=4); b3:0 reserved

name: FAN_COMMAND_1
description: Duty-cycle control 0-100%; device may override for temperature

name: IOUT_OC_WARN_LIMIT
description: Output over-current warning threshold in A

name: OT_WARN_LIMIT (Hot Spot)
description: Secondary ambient temperature warning threshold in degC; operating limit

name: STATUS_WORD
description: Summary of unit fault and warning status

name: STATUS_VOUT
description: b7 VOUT OV fault, b4 VOUT UV fault (only these listed)

name: STATUS_IOUT
description: b7 IOUT OC fault, b5 IOUT OC warning, b3 current share fault, b1 POUT_OP fault, b0 POUT_OP warning

name: STATUS_INPUT
description: b5 VIN UV warning, b4 VIN UV fault, b3 unit off for low input voltage, b1 IIN OC warning, b0 labelled POUT_OP_WARNING (likely a typo in the note)

name: STATUS_TEMPERATURE
description: b7 OT fault; b6 OT warning

name: STATUS_CML
description: b7 invalid/unsupported command; b6 invalid data; b5 PEC failed; b1 other communication fault

name: STATUS_MFR_SPECIFIC
description: b7 current share warning; b6 12Vaux UV or OC fault; b5 12V OC fault; b4 12Vaux OV fault; b3 12V UV fault; b2 12V OV fault; b1 thermal fault; b0 fan fault

name: STATUS_FANS_1_2
description: b7 fan1 fault; b5 fan1 warning
